info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Recovery Management API
info.description: The Account Recovery Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage customer account recovery processes. This API facilitates the updating of account recovery settings for customers, ensuring they can regain access to their accounts securely. Typical consumers of this API include customer support teams and account management systems seeking to enhance user experience by providing streamlined recovery solutions. The API is designed for use in scenarios where timely updates of recovery details are critical to maintaining customer satisfaction and trust.

patch.summary: Update account recovery details for a specific customer.
patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the account recovery information for a customer identified by a unique account ID. It enables the modification of various recovery parameters to assist customers in recovering their accounts more efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the account recovery details for the specified customer. It includes necessary information that is required for processing the account recovery request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and account recovery details updated.
